text:
Is that what you're saying?
...
Well, I suppose
it's only natural
that you'd suspect me...
But what could
I possibly gain
by setting a fire?
Well...
And one more thing.
If I were the culprit,
why would I go out of my way
to put it out?
Before that, shouldn't
you be asking why
I didn't run away?
That's true...
I'm sorry...
I jumped to conclusions.
You're right...
I'm sorry...
I jumped to conclusions.
It's fine.
Then I can
go now, can't I?
Yeah...
Yes...
I never imagined they'd
attack in such a way...
I know.
I think this
is going too far.
I know.
I think this
is going too far.
Fire...
I can't stand it...
Fariel?
I-I'm sorry.
I can't seem
to stop shaking...
I... died...
in a fire...
!?
I hate this.
It's so embarrassing...
Fariel...
It'll be all right!
It'll be all right!
I won't ever let
you go through that again.
I promise!
I won't ever let
you go through that again.
I promise!
●...
So, um...
Please, cheer up.
So, um...
Please, cheer up.
All right...
It was definitely
the Imperial soldiers
who set fire to the orchard.
The same scent from our last
battle with them was still there.
I see...
I see...
But I didn't catch
a woman's scent.
So at least it seems
your acquaintance didn't
set the fire herself.
Does that help
at all?
Yeah...
Thanks, Yafha.
Yes...
Thank you,
Yafha.
